name: Tern-class insertion carrier
role: Grav rapid-insertion transport: skims in under sensor cover from the orbital watch, hovers a metre off the ground with both side doors open so a Vigil fireteam can drop out in seconds, then covers the landing zone with door guns and lifts away.
drive: grav (four tilting lift rings) + rear thrust
capacity: 8 Vigilants in full exosuit (four per side on drop rails) + 2 door gunners from the squad

weapons.main: 2 pintle heavy repeaters in the side doors
chin-mounted rotary repeater + 2 stub-wing rocket pods (troops reduced to 6)
unarmed cargo/sling variant: belly winch for a Lantern pod or supply crate

blockout_note: Overlapping primitive shells at 1:56 mm (visual blockout, not a unioned print mesh).
